• Are you having trouble with these symptoms?
  • What is "HIFU"? “Sagging treatment” that can be done without cutting
  • Expected effects and duration of HIFU
  • Does HIFU hurt? What are the side effects and downtime?
  • Flow of treatment
  • Before and after
  • cost

Are you having trouble with these symptoms?

  • I'm starting to notice sagging on my face.
  • The sharpness of the face line has disappeared
  • I want to make my cheeks and jaw area look neater.
  • I want to lift up without using a scalpel
  • I want to get a synergistic effect when used in combination with thread lift.

What is "HIFU"? “Sagging treatment” that can be done without cutting

I'm concerned about sagging, but I'm reluctant to undergo surgical treatment such as using a scalpel.
For such people, we recommend HIFU, a treatment to improve sagging, make the face look smaller, and improve skin quality.
By concentrating ultrasonic waves on one point and instantaneously heating the area where you are concerned about sagging, you can achieve a pinpoint lift-up effect.

Expected effects and duration of HIFU

HIFU (High Intensity Focused Ultrasound) is a treatment that delivers ultrasonic thermal energy to the "SMAS layer" 4.5 mm below the skin and the "dermal layer" 3 mm below the skin, achieving a pinpoint lifting effect. Furthermore, by stimulating collagen production, you can expect a facial tightening effect.
Improves facial sagging without using a scalpel. We also recommend using it with a thread lift.

When can I feel the effects? How long does it last?

HIFU tightens the subcutaneous tissue immediately after the procedure, and the effects are immediately felt. Additionally, the slightly damaged tissues are rebuilt, and your skin will become firmer again about a month after the treatment.
The effect lasts approximately 3 months.

What is the pace of hospital visits and frequency of treatments to get results?

Since the effects last for about 3 months, we recommend regular treatments every 3 months. In most cases, you will notice a difference after just one treatment, but repeated treatments on a regular basis will promote collagen rebuilding and improve skin firmness.

Does HIFU hurt? What are the side effects and downtime?

Although it varies from person to person, some pain may occur depending on the area.
Basically, anesthesia is not required. Please rest assured that the output of HIFU can be adjusted.

Side effects/risks

  • There is some pain and a feeling of heat.
  • Redness will appear immediately after the procedure, but will subside within a few days.
  • Your skin will feel rough after the treatment, but it will subside within a week.
  • In rare cases, temporary dullness may occur.

Downtime and precautions

Treatment time: about 30-60 minutes
Downtime: None *There are individual differences

  • Please take adequate measures against UV rays and moisturize.
  • Make-up can be applied immediately after the treatment.
  • Please refrain from massaging your face for one week after the treatment.
  • You can take a shower or bath on the day of your treatment, but if you have any symptoms, please resume the next day.
  • Please refrain from drinking alcohol or strenuous exercise on the day of your treatment.

Clarification of information related to safety in other countries

In Japan, this product has not been approved under the Pharmaceutical and Medical Device Act.

About the acquisition route

All items are purchased from domestic distributors.
*Reference: Ministry of Health, Labor and Welfare's guidance regarding personal imports
https://www.yakubutsu.mhlw.go.jp/individualimport/healthhazard/

Other domestically approved drugs with the same ingredients and efficacy

There are no other domestically approved drugs that have the same ingredients and performance.
*This will be a free medical treatment.

Those who cannot receive HIFU

People who fall under the following conditions cannot receive HIFU treatment. Thank you for your understanding.

  • Those who are pregnant
  • People with keloid constitution
  • People with skin malignant tumors
  • People with a tendency to bleed
  • Those who have metal thread or metal plate inserted
  • Those using a cardiac pacemaker
  • People with heart disease

Flow of treatment

1Reservation/Reception

First, please make a reservation via web inquiry or telephone. After checking in, you will be asked to fill out a medical questionnaire.

2counseling

Staff or a doctor will provide counseling. We will ask you about the area and level of treatment you would like to treat, and then decide on a menu.
We will also explain side effects, risks, downtime, precautions, etc.

3Treatment

Apply gel and apply HIFU.

4Go home

After the treatment, we will check the condition of the affected area before you go home.
